cat > /workdir/analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
import arena
b=arena.load_board()
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile()
def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
for l in f:
 if 'uciok' in l:break
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256')
send('isready')
for l in f:
 if 'readyok' in l:break
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
sec=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 30
cmd='go movetime '+str(sec*1000)
if len(sys.argv)>2:cmd+=' searchmoves '+' '.join(sys.argv[2:])
send(cmd)
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('info depth') or l.startswith('bestmove'):print(l.strip(),flush=True)
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):break
send('quit')
PY
